en_title: Big Walk Developer Explains Why the Game Isn't on Xbox
subtitle: 抵制目标未变
opus_summary: 《Big Walk》开发商表示，游戏未登陆XBOX是为支持BDS抵制运动。在微软或XBOX不再被列为抵制目标之前，工作室不会在该平台推出游戏。IGN已向微软征求回应。

paragraphs.en: Big Walk developer House House has explained why it’s boycotting Xbox and thus why the game isn’t available on Microsoft's console.
paragraphs.cn: 《Big Walk》开发商House House解释了抵制XBOX的原因，这也是该作未登陆微软主机的原因。

paragraphs.en: House House, the Australian studio behind Untitled Goose Game, released clever co-op puzzle adventure Big Walk earlier this year on PC, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, leaving Xbox Series X and S out in the cold. Big Walk was critically acclaimed upon release, earning a 91 rating on Metacritic and multiple appearances on Game of the Year contender lists.
paragraphs.cn: 开发过《捣蛋大鹅》的澳大利亚工作室House House，今年早些时候在PC、PS5和Switch 2上推出了设计巧妙的合作解谜冒险游戏《Big Walk》，唯独没有登陆XBOX Series。《Big Walk》发售后广受好评，Metacritic评分达到91分，还多次入选年度游戏候选名单。

paragraphs.en: IGN’s Big Walk review returned a 9/10. We said: “Big Walk is a rewarding co-op adventure full of beautiful emergent moments as you find solutions to cleverly built puzzles and explore its vast open world with your friends.”
paragraphs.cn: IGN为《Big Walk》打出了9分（满分10分）。我们在评测中写道：「《Big Walk》是一款让人收获满满的合作冒险游戏。你与好友一同探索广阔的开放世界、解开设计巧妙的谜题时，会遇到许多自然涌现的美好瞬间。」

paragraphs.en: Since then, fans had wondered why the game failed to come out Xbox. In a statement published to its website , House House said it made the decision as part of its support for campaign group Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS), which describes itself as a “Palestinian-led movement for freedom, justice and equality.”
paragraphs.cn: 自那以后，粉丝们一直想知道，这款游戏为何没有登陆XBOX。House House在官网发布声明，表示这一决定是为了支持「抵制、撤资、制裁」（Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions，简称BDS）运动组织。该组织自称是「由巴勒斯坦人领导、争取自由、正义与平等的运动」。

paragraphs.en: IGN has asked Microsoft for comment.

BDS lists Xbox as a “priority” target, and has launched a campaign calling on gamers, streamers, and developers to boycott Microsoft’s gaming efforts. As reported by the BBC , Microsoft's work with the Israeli government has been a controversial issue, including within the company itself, prompting protests by some employees.
paragraphs.cn: BDS将XBOX列为「优先」抵制目标，并已发起行动，呼吁玩家、主播和开发者抵制微软的游戏业务。据BBC报道，微软与以色列政府的合作一直存在争议，公司内部也不例外，一些员工因此发起了抗议。

paragraphs.en: House House indicated that it won't release Big Walk on Xbox "until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets."
paragraphs.cn: House House表示，「在微软和／或XBOX不再被BDS列为抵制目标之前」，工作室不会在XBOX上推出《Big Walk》。
